rows.statement: Top end of NFL general manager pay: Nick Caserio (Texans) six-year deal (Jan 2021) reported as making him one of the three highest-paid GMs. Conflict on the figure: ProFootballTalk says $30M base over 6 years (=$5M/yr, max $36M = $6M/yr); Houston Chronicle (via theScore) says at least $6M/yr average.

sources.citation: ProFootballTalk (NBC Sports): Six years, $30 million for Nick Caserio (https://nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/six-years-30-million-for-nick-caserio; 2021-01-06)
sources.quote: six-year deal with a base value of $30 million ... $36 million

sources.citation: theScore (citing Aaron Wilson, Houston Chronicle, and ESPN's Adam Schefter): Report: Caserio to earn $6M per year, one of 3 highest-paid GMs in NFL (https://thescore.com/nfl/news/2086409/report-caserio-to-earn-6-m-per-year-one-of-3-highest-paid-gms-in-nfl; undated (Jan 2021))
sources.quote: Caserio will average at least $6 million per year.

sources.citation: Bleacher Report (citing Florio/PFT and Schefter): Report: Nick Caserio to Be Among Top-Paid GMs Under 6-Year Texans Contract (https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2925793-report-nick-caserio-to-be-among-top-paid-gms-under-6-year-texans-contract; 2021-01-06)
sources.quote: According to Mike Florio of ProFootballTalk, Caserio's deal has a base value of $30 million and can max out at $36 million.

sources.citation: WEEI (Audacy): Nick Caserio's contract details with Texans a bit surprising (https://www.audacy.com/weei/sports/patriots/nick-caserios-contract-details-with-texans-a-bit-surprising; 2021-01-06)
sources.quote: The deal is for six years and makes him one of the three highest-paid GMs in the league.

rows.notes: Key pay-nfl-gm-top. CONFLICT: $5M/yr base (PFT/Florio) vs 'at least $6M' (Houston Chronicle/Wilson). Max per PFT is also $6M/yr, so the two agree on $6M as a ceiling. 'Top-3 highest paid' comes from ESPN Schefter, relayed by 3 outlets (single underlying source). NFL GM pay is not disclosed by teams; all figures are leaks. Count: 2 independent figure sources (PFT, Houston Chronicle), 1 for ranking (ESPN). No newer top GM figure found. sources.quote: General managers typically make around $1 million per year on the lower end of the spectrum, up to $7.5 million.

rows.notes: Key pay-nfl-gm-range. ANECDOTAL ONLY. Neither source cites primary data.
